scope: CPU consolidation. Every number is cited to an artifact; none is measured here.

baseline.source: c10-bare-baseline bc66f7d6d, 16 folds per size, min=max=1350 MHz

ladder.item: ttnn trace of the diffusion loop
ladder.mechanism: replay one captured graph per sampling step, removing the host's per-call dispatch for 219,200 of the fold's ~287,000 program-launching calls -- which it does, and the fold does not get shorter
ladder.evidence: measured on Blackhole at a recorded clock
ladder.basis: REFUTED. Sized at 3.02 s from the clock-immune term times the diffusion loop's 76 % share of launching calls; c10-trace-lever then measured -0.0214 s at 512 aa and -0.0161 s at 298 aa at a pinned 1350 MHz, both inside their own A/A floors of 0.055 s and 0.043 s, and the null reproduces at 1000 MHz. The call arithmetic was right and the inference from it was wrong
ladder.accuracy_spend: none, and it was free to check: one CIF digest per size across all 40 accepted folds, identical in both arms, max Kabsch RMSD 3.7e-15 A

ladder.item: cut the rest of the clock-immune term
ladder.mechanism: featurization, MSA handling, output writing and whatever dispatch the trace does not reach
ladder.basis: the WHOLE 3.9830 s clock-immune term is now unattributed, not 0.93 s of it: the trace reaches none of it. Two independent lines say it is not host dispatch -- the trace null, and F scaling at N^1.32 +- 0.07, 19 sigma from size-independent. A term that grows at N^1.3 and survives dispatch removal looks like DRAM-bound device time, which AICLK does not drive. No value can be quoted until something measures what it is made of
ladder.accuracy_spend: unknown, depends entirely on what it turns out to be
ladder.row: c10-fold-census owes the split; no row attacks it yet

ladder.item: per-class grid sizing, trimul and triangle attention
ladder.mechanism: fewer cores for a class whose parallel efficiency falls off, more for one whose does not
ladder.evidence: transferred across architectures, not measured here
ladder.basis: the ledger's 810 Mcycles came from a Wormhole 8x9 sweep where the two classes move in OPPOSITE directions; no Blackhole core sweep exists. Withdrawn as a value. Blackhole does show trimul at 11.47 TFLOP/s against a same-session dense cube's 67.59
ladder.accuracy_spend: a grid change can alter reduction order; digest check needed

ladder.mechanism: a default-ON flag whose value is not known to be positive
ladder.basis: the ledger puts it between -623 and +281 Mcycles, i.e. -0.46 s to +0.21 s at 1350 MHz. The downside is a live loss on a shipped default
ladder.accuracy_spend: digest check; it routes a grid decision

ladder.evidence: measured on Wormhole, clock not recorded
ladder.basis: 1.04124x on the Wormhole step, about 162 Mcycles if it transfers at full value. Never measured on Blackhole
ladder.accuracy_spend: 0.346 A of the 0.60 A bar alone; 0.713 A jointly with HEAD_PAD_TAIL, over the bar, so the two cannot ship together

ladder.mechanism: pad the head tail so the token DiT head widths stop splitting
ladder.evidence: measured on Wormhole, clock not recorded
ladder.basis: 0.211 s on a Wormhole fold with 72 of its 96 sites OUTSIDE the diffusion step, so pricing it as a step-only 1.02549x lever under-prices it by roughly 4x
ladder.accuracy_spend: 0.3696 A at 512 aa, not bit-exact; excludes DIT_FUSED_QKV

ladder.item: the byte axis, all remaining levers together
ladder.mechanism: delete bytes in the elementwise tail
ladder.evidence: measured on Blackhole, clock not recorded
ladder.basis: CEILING, not a value: deleting EVERY byte takes the floor 12.706 -> 8.543 s, 1.487x, and the headroom is concentrated in multiply_ 0.770 s, layer_norm 0.665 s, add_ 0.640 s and permute 0.256 s. The corpus independently caps the byte axis at 1.470x. Levers already shipped have consumed an unknown part of it
ladder.status: closed as a ceiling, not a candidate

items: ttnn trace of the diffusion loop

honest_reading: Nothing in this table has been measured as a fold-level win yet. Cycles saved to date: zero. Accuracy spent to date: none.

Two of the priced rows are DERIVED, meaning arithmetic over measured artifacts rather than a measured lever, and two are Wormhole numbers that have never run on Blackhole. Do not read the total as a forecast.
The two Wormhole rows cannot both ship: jointly they are 0.713 A against a 0.60 A bar.
Perturbations stack strongly sub-additively on this fixture, so a stack must be measured as a stack and never by summing individual readings. This total is an inventory, not a prediction.

If every priced row landed at its full value the fold would read 14.67 s, which is above the 10.0 s target. On present evidence the target needs either the clock-immune term to give up something the trace demonstrably does not reach, or a device-work lever nobody has found. The one sized candidate left is the size-independent share of the work term, 3,301 to 8,220 Mcycles, which c10-size-scaling is measuring. nobody has found yet.
